setup: You are adding [[a]] and [[b]], and the ones digits force a carry.

steps.say: The ones digits are [[ones_a]] and [[ones_b]]. Together they make [[ones_a]] + [[ones_b]], which is 10 or more — this is the carry case.
Write the ones digit of the total in the ones column and carry the ten leftwards, adding it to the tens column.

answer: The carry is what makes this more than a digit-by-digit sum: [[a]] + [[b]] = [[sum]].
